note: 由 scripts/gen-name-tables-more.py 產生（C#、Ruby、Lua；補強 Python、Java、JavaScript）。名稱是依官方文件知識整理，沒有逐條對照；有錯用 behavior_define 修正。

data_structures_algorithms.label: Data structures / algorithms
data_structures_algorithms.description: Sorts, searches, groups or transforms collections (sort/heap/set/map/queue helpers) - the computational core rather than I/O.

File.ReadAllText.summary: Reads the ENTIRE text file into one string (opens, reads, closes).

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.meaning: text encoding (default UTF-8 with BOM detection)

return.meaning: the file contents; throws FileNotFoundException / DirectoryNotFoundException / UnauthorizedAccessException / IOException on failure

File.ReadAllTextAsync.summary: Asynchronously reads the ENTIRE text file into one string.

return.meaning: a Task<string> with the file contents (exceptions surface when awaited)

File.ReadAllLines.summary: Reads a text file into a string[] with one element per line.

return.meaning: the lines (without line terminators); throws on I/O failure

File.WriteAllText.summary: Creates or OVERWRITES a file with the given text (opens, writes, closes).

File.AppendAllText.summary: Appends text to the end of a file, creating it if it does not exist.

File.Exists.summary: Checks whether a FILE exists at the path (returns false for directories and for any error such as a permission problem).

rules.meaning: no file there (or the check itself failed)

File.Delete.summary: Deletes the file; no error if the file does not exist (but the directory must).

Directory.CreateDirectory.summary: Creates the directory and any missing parent directories; does nothing if it already exists.

Path.Combine.summary: Joins path segments with the platform separator (a later rooted segment RESETS the path).

Console.WriteLine.summary: Writes the text followed by a newline to standard output.

parameters.name: value
parameters.meaning: text or object to print (formatted with ToString)

Console.Error.WriteLine.summary: Writes the text followed by a newline to standard ERROR.

Process.Start.summary: Starts an operating-system process (or opens a document/URL with its default program).

parameters.name: startInfo
parameters.meaning: ProcessStartInfo: file name, arguments, redirection, working directory

return.meaning: the Process object (null if an existing process was reused)

Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable.summary: Reads one environment variable of the current process.

return.meaning: its value, or null when it is not set

Environment.Exit.summary: Terminates the process immediately with the given exit code (finally blocks do NOT run for other threads).

Thread.Sleep.summary: Blocks the CURRENT thread for the given time (use Task.Delay in async code).

parameters.name: millisecondsTimeout
parameters.meaning: how long to block, in ms

Task.Run.summary: Queues work on the thread pool and returns a Task for it.

return.meaning: a Task (or Task<T>) you can await; exceptions surface when awaited

Task.Delay.summary: Creates a Task that completes after the delay WITHOUT blocking a thread.

JsonSerializer.Deserialize.summary: Parses JSON text into an object of the given type (System.Text.Json).

return.meaning: the object; throws JsonException on malformed JSON (null for the JSON literal null)

JsonSerializer.Serialize.summary: Converts an object into JSON text (System.Text.Json).

JsonConvert.DeserializeObject.summary: Parses JSON text into an object (Newtonsoft.Json).

return.meaning: the object (null for empty input); throws JsonException on malformed JSON

HttpClient.summary: Creates an HTTP client — reuse ONE instance per process (creating one per request exhausts sockets).

.GetAsync.summary: Sends an HTTP GET and completes when the response headers arrive.

return.meaning: a Task<HttpResponseMessage> (check IsSuccessStatusCode / EnsureSuccessStatusCode; network failures throw HttpRequestException)

.PostAsync.summary: Sends an HTTP POST with the given content.

.EnsureSuccessStatusCode.summary: Throws HttpRequestException when the HTTP status is not 2xx.

return.meaning: the same response object when it was successful

.ExecuteNonQuery.summary: Runs an INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL statement that returns no rows.

return.meaning: the number of rows affected (-1 for statements that are not DML)

.ExecuteReader.summary: Runs a query and returns a forward-only reader over the result rows.

return.meaning: a DbDataReader — call Read() per row and dispose it

.ExecuteScalar.summary: Runs a query and returns the first column of the first row.

return.meaning: that value as object (null / DBNull when there are no rows)

.SaveChanges.summary: Writes all tracked entity changes to the database in one transaction (Entity Framework).

Regex.IsMatch.summary: Tests whether the pattern matches anywhere in the input.

return.meaning: true if there is a match

SHA256.HashData.summary: Computes the SHA-256 digest of the bytes in one call.

GC.Collect.summary: Forces a garbage collection now (rarely the right fix; mostly for tests and diagnostics).

Marshal.AllocHGlobal.summary: Allocates UNMANAGED memory — you must free it with Marshal.FreeHGlobal.

GL.Clear.summary: Clears the selected buffers (color/depth/stencil) of the current OpenGL framebuffer.

GL.DrawElements.summary: Draws primitives using an index buffer.

parameters.name: indices
parameters.meaning: offset into the bound element buffer

SDL.SDL_PollEvent.summary: Polls for a pending SDL event WITHOUT blocking.

return.meaning: non-zero when an event was stored, 0 when the queue is empty

rules.meaning: an event was written to e

SDL.SDL_GL_SwapWindow.summary: Presents the window's OpenGL back buffer (call once per frame after drawing).

parameters.name: fieldOfView
parameters.meaning: vertical field of view in radians

File.read.summary: Reads the ENTIRE file into one string (opens, reads, closes).

parameters.name: length
parameters.meaning: optional: only the first N bytes

parameters.name: offset
parameters.meaning: optional: start reading at this byte

return.meaning: the contents as a String (raises Errno::ENOENT when the file is missing, Errno::EACCES when not permitted)

File.write.summary: Writes a string to a file, TRUNCATING it first (opens, writes, closes).

parameters.name: mode
parameters.meaning: optional: pass mode: "a" to append instead of truncate

File.open.summary: Opens a file; with a block the file is closed automatically when the block ends.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.meaning: "r" read, "w" truncate+write, "a" append, "r+" read/write, add "b" for binary

return.meaning: a File object (or the block's value when a block is given); raises Errno::ENOENT etc. on failure

File.exist?.summary: Checks whether a file or directory exists at the path.

File.delete.summary: Deletes the named files (raises if one does not exist).

Dir.mkdir.summary: Creates ONE directory (the parent must exist; use FileUtils.mkdir_p for the whole path).

return.meaning: 0 on success; raises Errno::EEXIST / Errno::ENOENT on failure

FileUtils.mkdir_p.summary: Creates the directory and any missing parents (like mkdir -p); no error if it exists.

FileUtils.rm_rf.summary: Recursively deletes files/directories and IGNORES errors (like rm -rf) — dangerous with a wrong path.

puts.summary: Writes each argument followed by a newline to standard output (arrays are printed one element per line).

system.summary: Runs a command in a subshell (or directly when given separate arguments), waits for it, and shows its output on the terminal.

parameters.name: command
parameters.meaning: the command line, or the program followed by its arguments

return.meaning: true if it exited with status 0, false if it exited non-zero, nil if the command could not be run

Open3.capture2.summary: Runs a command, feeds it stdin_data, and returns its stdout and exit status (no terminal output).

parameters.name: stdin_data
parameters.meaning: text to send to its standard input

Process.spawn.summary: Starts a command in a NEW process WITHOUT waiting for it.

return.meaning: the child process id (wait for it with Process.wait)

Thread.new.summary: Starts a new thread running the block.

return.meaning: the Thread; call join/value to wait; an exception inside is re-raised in the joiner

JSON.parse.summary: Parses JSON text into Ruby Hashes/Arrays/values.

return.meaning: the parsed structure; raises JSON::ParserError on malformed input

YAML.load_file.summary: Parses a YAML file (check the safe-loading rules of your Psych version).

Net::HTTP.get.summary: Sends an HTTP GET and returns only the response BODY.

return.meaning: the body String (raises on network errors; does NOT check the status code)

Net::HTTP.start.summary: Opens an HTTP connection, yields it, and closes it afterwards.

Digest::SHA256.hexdigest.summary: Computes the SHA-256 of a string and returns it as lowercase hex.

SecureRandom.hex.summary: Generates cryptographically secure random bytes as a hex string.

parameters.name: n
parameters.meaning: number of random BYTES (the string is twice as long)

ENV.fetch.summary: Reads an environment variable; raises KeyError when it is missing unless a default is given.

raise.summary: Raises an exception (RuntimeError when only a message is given) — control leaves the method unless rescued.

exit.summary: Terminates the program (raises SystemExit so ensure blocks and at_exit handlers run).

sleep.summary: Pauses the current thread for the given number of seconds (forever when no argument).

ActiveRecord::Base.establish_connection.summary: Opens (configures) the database connection used by ActiveRecord models.

parameters.name: spec
parameters.meaning: a config hash, URL, or environment name

Logger.new.summary: Creates a logger that writes to a file, IO or $stdout.

io.open.summary: Opens a file; returns a file handle (check for nil — it does NOT raise).

parameters.name: mode
parameters.meaning: "r" read, "w" truncate+write, "a" append, "r+"/"w+"/"a+" read/write, add "b" for binary

return.meaning: a file handle, or nil plus an error message and error code when it cannot be opened

rules.meaning: nil result: the file could not be opened (check the error message)

io.lines.summary: Iterates over the lines of a file (opens it, closes it when the loop ends).

parameters.name: formats
parameters.meaning: optional read formats, default "l" = line without newline

return.meaning: an iterator function; raises an error if the file cannot be opened

io.write.summary: Writes the arguments to the default OUTPUT file (standard output unless changed with io.output).

return.meaning: the file handle (so calls can be chained)

io.popen.summary: Starts a shell command and returns a file handle connected to its standard output ("r") or input ("w").

return.meaning: a file handle (read it with :read, close it with :close which returns the exit status)

os.execute.summary: Runs a shell command and waits for it (output goes to the terminal).

parameters.name: command
parameters.meaning: the shell command; with no argument it only tells whether a shell is available

return.meaning: true/nil, then "exit" or "signal", then the exit code (Lua 5.2+); in Lua 5.1 only the status code
its value as a string, or nil when it is not set

os.time.summary: With no argument: the current time as seconds since the epoch; with a table: converts a date table to seconds.

os.date.summary: Formats a time (default: now) as a string or as a date table (format "*t").

parameters.name: format
parameters.meaning: strftime-style format; "*t" returns a table, "!" prefix means UTC

os.clock.summary: CPU time used by the program in seconds (NOT wall-clock time).

os.remove.summary: Deletes a file or an empty directory.

return.meaning: true on success, or nil plus an error message and code on failure

parameters.name: code
parameters.meaning: true/0 = success, false or a non-zero number = failure

parameters.name: close
parameters.meaning: optional: close the Lua state first

print.summary: Writes its arguments (converted with tostring, separated by tabs) and a newline to standard output.

string.format.summary: Builds a string from a C-printf-style format (%d %s %f %x %q ...).

return.meaning: the formatted string; raises an error when a value does not fit its specifier (e.g. %d with a non-integer)

pcall.summary: Calls a function in PROTECTED mode: an error inside does not propagate, it is returned instead.

return.meaning: true plus its results on success, or false plus the error value on failure

rules.meaning: false: the call raised an error (second value is the error)

error.summary: Raises an error — control leaves the current function and unwinds to the nearest pcall.

parameters.name: level
parameters.meaning: where to blame: 1 = this call (default), 2 = the caller

require.summary: Loads a module once (cached in package.loaded) and returns what it returns.

parameters.name: modname
parameters.meaning: module name, searched via package.path / package.cpath

return.meaning: the module value; raises an error when the module cannot be found

table.insert.summary: Inserts a value at the end of a list, or at a position (shifting the rest up).

table.sort.summary: Sorts the list IN PLACE (not stable); an inconsistent comparison function raises "invalid order function".

parameters.name: comp
parameters.meaning: optional comparison function (a,b) -> true when a must come first

table.concat.summary: Joins the elements of a list (strings or numbers) with a separator.

coroutine.wrap.summary: Creates a coroutine and returns a plain function that resumes it each time it is called.

return.meaning: a function; errors inside propagate to the caller (unlike coroutine.resume)

coroutine.yield.summary: Suspends the running coroutine and returns control to whoever resumed it.

return.meaning: the values passed to the next resume

math.random.summary: Pseudo-random number: no argument → float in [0,1); (n) → integer in [1,n]; (m,n) → integer in [m,n].

socket.tcp.summary: Creates an unconnected TCP master socket (LuaSocket).

return.meaning: the socket object; call :connect or :bind/:listen on it

setmetatable.summary: Sets the metatable of a table (operator overloading, __index inheritance, __gc, ...).

collectgarbage.summary: Controls the garbage collector: "collect" runs a full cycle, "count" returns memory in use (KB), "stop"/"restart", "step", ...

open.summary: Opens a file and returns a file object.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.meaning: "r" read text, "w" truncate+write, "a" append, "x" create-only, add "b" for binary, "+" for update

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.meaning: text encoding (text mode only; defaults to the locale encoding)

return.meaning: a file object (raises FileNotFoundError / PermissionError / IsADirectoryError when it cannot be opened); use `with` so it is closed

json.loads.summary: Parses a JSON string into Python dicts/lists/values.

return.meaning: the parsed object; raises json.JSONDecodeError on malformed JSON

json.load.summary: Parses JSON read from a file object.

return.meaning: the parsed object; raises json.JSONDecodeError on malformed JSON

json.dumps.summary: Serializes a Python object to a JSON string.

return.meaning: the JSON string; raises TypeError for objects that are not JSON serializable

time.time.summary: Reads the current wall-clock time (can jump when the clock is adjusted — use time.monotonic for durations).

return.meaning: seconds since the epoch as a float

time.sleep.summary: Blocks the current thread for the given time (in async code use asyncio.sleep).

logging.info.summary: Logs a message at INFO level on the root logger (does nothing visible until logging.basicConfig or a handler is configured).

subprocess.run.summary: Runs a command, waits for it, and returns a CompletedProcess.

parameters.name: args
parameters.meaning: the command: a list (preferred) or a string with shell=True

parameters.name: check
parameters.meaning: True to raise CalledProcessError on a non-zero exit

return.meaning: a CompletedProcess with returncode, stdout, stderr (shell=True with untrusted input is a command-injection risk)

subprocess.Popen.summary: Starts a process WITHOUT waiting for it.

os.system.summary: Runs a command line in a subshell and waits for it.

os.makedirs.summary: Creates a directory and all missing parents.

parameters.name: exist_ok
parameters.meaning: True to not raise when it already exists

return.meaning: None; raises FileExistsError when it exists and exist_ok is False

os.listdir.summary: Lists the names in a directory (no recursion, arbitrary order).

shutil.rmtree.summary: Recursively deletes a directory tree — irreversible.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.meaning: seconds (there is NO default timeout — always set one)

return.meaning: a Response (status_code, text, json(); call raise_for_status() to turn 4xx/5xx into exceptions)

socket.socket.summary: Creates a socket object (TCP by default: AF_INET + SOCK_STREAM).

return.meaning: a socket; call connect/bind/listen on it

threading.Thread.summary: Creates a thread object; nothing runs until start() is called.

parameters.name: daemon
parameters.meaning: True so it does not keep the process alive

return.meaning: a Thread; call start() then join()

sqlite3.connect.summary: Opens (or creates) a SQLite database file.

return.meaning: a Connection; call commit() to persist changes, close() when done

random.random.summary: A pseudo-random float in [0.0, 1.0) — NOT suitable for secrets (use the secrets module).

parameters.name: default
parameters.meaning: value to return when it is not set

return.meaning: its value, or the default (None) when not set

sys.exit.summary: Raises SystemExit — the interpreter exits after finally/atexit handlers run.

parameters.name: arg
parameters.meaning: 0/None success; an int exit code; a string is printed to stderr and exits with 1

eval.summary: Evaluates a Python EXPRESSION from a string — never use it on untrusted input.

logger.error.summary: Logs a message at ERROR level on this logger.

parameters.name: exc_info
parameters.meaning: True to attach the current traceback

zipfile.ZipFile.summary: Opens a ZIP archive for reading ("r"), writing ("w") or appending ("a").

return.meaning: a ZipFile (use `with`); extractall() on untrusted archives can write outside the target folder (zip-slip)

Files.readAllLines.summary: Reads a whole text file as a list of lines.

return.meaning: the lines (throws IOException on failure, MalformedInputException on bad encoding)

Files.readString.summary: Reads a whole file into one String (Java 11+).

Files.write.summary: Writes bytes (or lines) to a file, creating or truncating it unless options say otherwise.

Files.exists.summary: Tests whether a file or directory exists (false also when the answer cannot be determined).

Files.delete.summary: Deletes a file or an EMPTY directory (throws NoSuchFileException when missing; use deleteIfExists to ignore that).

Files.createDirectories.summary: Creates a directory including all missing parents; no error if it already exists.

Files.walk.summary: Lazily walks a directory tree as a Stream<Path> — close it (try-with-resources) to release directory handles.

System.out.println.summary: Prints the value followed by a line separator to standard output.

System.err.println.summary: Prints the value followed by a line separator to standard ERROR.

System.getenv.summary: Reads an environment variable (or, with no argument, all of them as a Map).

return.meaning: its value, or null when it is not set

System.exit.summary: Terminates the JVM (runs shutdown hooks; finally blocks of other threads do NOT run).

System.currentTimeMillis.summary: Reads the wall-clock time in milliseconds since the epoch (use System.nanoTime for measuring durations).

Thread.sleep.summary: Blocks the CURRENT thread; interruption throws InterruptedException (restore the flag with Thread.currentThread().interrupt()).

Executors.newFixedThreadPool.summary: Creates a thread pool with a fixed number of worker threads — call shutdown() when done.

HttpClient.newHttpClient.summary: Creates a default java.net.http HTTP client (Java 11+); reuse one instance.

DriverManager.getConnection.summary: Opens a JDBC connection to a database URL.

return.meaning: a Connection (throws SQLException); always close it (try-with-resources)

executeQuery.summary: Runs a SELECT and returns a ResultSet.

parameters.name: sql
parameters.meaning: the query (use PreparedStatement parameters, never string concatenation)

return.meaning: a ResultSet — call next() per row
the number of rows affected (0 for DDL)

MessageDigest.getInstance.summary: Creates a hash function object by algorithm name (e.g. "SHA-256"; MD5/SHA-1 are not collision resistant).

Class.forName.summary: Loads a class by NAME at runtime (and initializes it).

Runtime.getRuntime.summary: Returns the Runtime of the JVM — used for exec(), memory info, shutdown hooks.

printStackTrace.summary: Prints the exception and its stack trace to standard error (consider a logger instead).

fs.readFileSync.summary: Reads a whole file SYNCHRONOUSLY (blocks the event loop).

parameters.name: options
parameters.meaning: encoding such as "utf8" (without it you get a Buffer)

return.meaning: the contents (string or Buffer); throws ENOENT/EACCES/EISDIR on failure

fs.readFile.summary: Reads a whole file asynchronously (callback style).

return.meaning: nothing — the result arrives in the callback

fs.writeFileSync.summary: Writes data to a file SYNCHRONOUSLY, creating or TRUNCATING it.

parameters.name: options
parameters.meaning: encoding / mode / flag (use flag "a" to append)

fs.existsSync.summary: Tests whether a path exists (does not throw).

rules.meaning: it does not exist (or is not accessible)

fs.mkdirSync.summary: Creates a directory (add {recursive:true} to create parents and ignore an existing one).

return.meaning: the first directory created (with recursive) or undefined; throws EEXIST without recursive

fs.rmSync.summary: Removes a file or directory (use {recursive:true, force:true} for rm -rf semantics).

console.log.summary: Prints its arguments to standard output (the browser console in a page).

console.error.summary: Prints its arguments to standard ERROR.

JSON.parse.summary: Parses a JSON string into a JavaScript value.

return.meaning: the parsed value; throws SyntaxError on malformed JSON

JSON.stringify.summary: Converts a value to a JSON string (drops functions/undefined, throws on circular references and BigInt).

return.meaning: the JSON string (undefined for unsupported top-level values)

fetch.summary: Starts an HTTP request and resolves when the response HEADERS arrive — it does NOT reject on 4xx/5xx (check response.ok).

return.meaning: a Promise<Response>; rejects only on network failure/abort

child_process.execSync.summary: Runs a shell command and BLOCKS until it finishes.

return.meaning: its stdout (Buffer or string); throws when the exit code is non-zero (command injection risk with untrusted input)

spawn.summary: Starts a process WITHOUT a shell and returns immediately with streams.

setTimeout.summary: Runs a function once after a delay (the delay is a minimum, not exact).

setInterval.summary: Runs a function repeatedly with a delay between calls until cleared.

Math.random.summary: A pseudo-random number in [0,1) — NOT cryptographically secure.

process.exit.summary: Terminates the Node.js process immediately (pending async work is dropped).

localStorage.setItem.summary: Stores a string under a key in the browser's localStorage (synchronous, persists across sessions, ~5 MB).

addEventListener.summary: Registers a function to be called when the event fires on the target.

Promise.all.summary: Waits for ALL promises; rejects immediately when any one rejects.

return.meaning: a Promise of the array of results (in input order)
